args.sql:
SELECT 
    c.containregistry AS container_id, 
    ROUND(AVG(s.tempstabidx), 2) AS stability_score, 
    ROUND(MAX(s.tempmaxc), 2) AS max_temp_breach_severity, 
    dl.syshealth AS overall_status 
FROM 
    container c 
JOIN 
    sensordata s ON c.containregistry = s.containlink 
JOIN 
    datalogger dl ON c.containregistry = dl.containlog 
GROUP BY 
    c.containregistry, dl.syshealth 
LIMIT 100;
